players.name: Carson Beck
players.summary: Beck (back) will not practice Friday, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

players.name: James Conner
players.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.summary: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.summary: out

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jackson Hawes
players.summary: Hawes (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Matt Parrino reports.

players.name: Tommy Tremble
players.summary: Tremble (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Darren Waller
players.summary: Waller (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Zavion Thomas
players.summary: Thomas (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Saints.

players.name: Zavier Scott
players.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Iosivas (thumb) practiced fully Thursday, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Luke Schoonmaker
players.summary: Schoonmaker (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

players.name: Jonathan Mingo
players.summary: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.summary: Ferguson didn't practice Wednesday due to knee and ankle injuries and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

players.name: Sione Vaki
players.summary: Vaki (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.summary: Jacobs (finger) is participating in Saturday's practice session, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.summary: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Bo Melton
players.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Kayshon Boutte
players.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Riley Leonard
players.summary: The Colts announced Friday that Leonard will act as Anthony Richardson's backup at quarterback, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.summary: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.summary: Walker (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

players.name: Jared Wiley
players.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that Bowers (ankle) is slated to be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Jets.

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.summary: Kolar (concussion) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.summary: McConkey (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.summary: Coach Sean McVay noted Friday that Adams (hamstring) isn't expected to practice this weekend, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.summary: Ferguson (hamstring/ankle) isn't ready to return to game action, but the Rams still plan to activate him from injured reserve before Week 12 and keep him on the active roster, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Coach Sean McVay revealed Friday that Nacua (knee) had surgery to repair his MCL on Tuesday and is on track to miss a couple of months, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.summary: Wayne (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown (hamstring) is expected to miss multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.summary: Maye has suffered a fractured right fibula that won't require surgery but is expected to sideline him for some time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.summary: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isaiah Williams
players.summary: Williams (ribs) won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: Coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Cooper (ankle/hip) will be out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.summary: Shipley (foot/illness) didn't practice Friday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest versus the Steelers.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.summary: Wicks (ankle/foot) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.summary: Wilson (finger) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Mark Kaboly reports.

players.name: Jordan James
players.summary: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.

players.name: Mac Jones
players.summary: Jones (illness) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers will make a decision on Evans' (Achilles) Week 11 status Saturday after listing the wide receiver as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City, Matt Barrows of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Isaac Guerendo
players.summary: Guerendo (pectoral) was working off to the side during practice Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.summary: Kirk announced Wednesday via his personal Instagram account that he recently underwent meniscus surgery.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: Stribling (ankle) was doing some work on the side at Wednesday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.summary: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

players.name: George Holani
players.summary: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.summary: Mayfield (thumb) is dealing with a plantar fascia injury in his foot, and he would wear a special orthotic and new cleats to stabilize his foot if he's cleared to play against the Lions on Sunday, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.summary: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.summary: Tate (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys but is "considered likely" to be cleared to play, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.summary: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.summary: White (heel) is trending toward being available for Monday's game against the Bengals, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.summary: Croskey-Merritt (groin) is trending toward playing in Monday night's game against the Bengals, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.summary: Burks (foot) did not practice Friday.
